column1: # Pinyin dict build-time Q4 log-prior boosts — `(word, boost_q4)`
# pairs added to log_prior_q4 at IDF snapshot build time. Applied per-
# word (regardless of code) so e.g. boosting 继续 lifts every
# (code, 继续) entry uniformly.
# Calibration: each boost is the Q4 amount needed to clear the canon
# competitor under the Q4-log additive sort key
# (`score_q4 = log_prior + log_likelihood`) plus a small safety margin.
# Q4=16, so +11 ≈ ×2.0 linear, +17 ≈ ×2.9. Prefer small boosts (≤17);
# anything larger suggests the upstream corpus is fundamentally wrong
# about the word and the dict-pipeline source should be fixed instead.
# Format:
#   <word>\t<boost_q4>[\t# comment]
# Loaded by `idf_from_pinyin_dict.rs` via `include_str!` so the file is
# tracked as a cargo build dependency. New entries MUST add a
# regression test in `dispatch.rs` / `session.rs` pinning the expected
# ranking and cite the user polish-log case in the same commit.
# Sort alphabetically by Chinese for human review.
